entities.name: Clinic Management System (CMS)
entities.description: Manages patient admissions, EMRs, scheduling, and billing for healthcare facilities while ensuring strict HIPAA/GDPR compliance and 99.99% availability.

entities.name: Patients
entities.description: Patients interacting with the clinic management system for scheduling and personal records.

entities.name: Clinicians / Medical Staff
entities.description: Medical professionals managing electronic medical records (EMRs) and patient care.

entities.name: Administrative / Billing Staff
entities.description: Staff managing patient admissions, scheduling, and billing operations.

entities.name: External Labs/Imaging
entities.description: External systems providing laboratory and imaging results via FHIR APIs.

entities.name: Insurance Payment Gateways
entities.description: External payment processors handling insurance billing and transactions.

entities.name: Identity Provider (IdP)
entities.description: External identity provider managing authentication, federation, and step-up MFA.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.description: Manages incoming traffic and enforces security policies.

entities.name: Hardware Security Module (HSM)
entities.description: Provides FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic operations and key management.

entities.name: WORM Audit Logging Service
entities.description: Provides asynchronous WORM auditing for compliance and security.

entities.name: FHIR Integration Engine
entities.description: Handles HL7 FHIR interoperability and exchanges clinical data.

entities.name: Patient Portal
entities.description: Provides patients access to scheduling and personal records.

entities.name: Clinical Workspace
entities.description: Provides medical professionals tools for managing EMRs and patient care.

entities.name: Billing & Admin Suite
entities.description: Handles patient admissions, scheduling, and billing operations.

entities.name: Core Datastore
entities.description: Manages persistent storage with localized read replicas and primary master for writes.

naming_conventions: Core systems are referred to by full descriptive titles like Clinic Management System (CMS)
Infrastructure and security components use explicit descriptive titles such as WORM Audit Logging Service and Hardware Security Module (HSM)
Internal container elements are named using functional domain roles such as Patient Portal, Clinical Workspace, and Billing & Admin Suite
